name: coach-connect
description: Coach-Connect — Intelligent stall recommendation for rail travel (passenger website)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
